description:
Make examples answer “Can Jido do my job?” and “Can I run the proof?”

Exit criteria:
- Every home use case links to a relevant example.
- Every public example has a task, outcome, packages, maturity, prerequisites, expected result, source, and validation date.
- Production claims have direct failure, state, trace, and deployment proof.
- Operational-control claims link to one integrated example and to small examples for denial, quotas, causal history, telemetry, and redaction.

Backlog tasks: 46

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md
title: E08 — Turn examples into direct proof
